## Key terms

{{< glossary frame-rate frame-time stutter one-percent-low thermal-throttling frame-rate-cap compatibility api-level graphics-api compatibility-matrix release-notes reliable-source >}}

## 27.1 Measuring performance

- **Frame time:** 60 fps ≈ 16.7 ms; 30 fps ≈ 33.3 ms.
- **1 % low:** the slowest frames; **stutters** hide in the average.
- Also: load time, battery, temperature.

![Frame times (example values).](images/frame-times.png){width=94%}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
A high average with stutters feels worse than a steady 30 fps.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · Frame times"}
Frame times of 30, 60 and 120 fps; what fps is a 50 ms frame?
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 1 · Measures"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="100 ms|0 ms"}
the frame time at 60 fps
:   about 16.7 ms

the frame time at 30 fps
:   about 33.3 ms

the number that shows stutters
:   the 1 % low

a single 50 ms frame in a 60 fps race
:   a stutter
:::
:::

## 27.2 Case study: heat, throttling and a cap

- A long, heavy load heats the chip: **thermal throttling**.
- The frame rate falls and jumps.
- A **frame-rate cap** or lower settings: steady, cooler, longer battery.

![The P5 in a 20-minute race.](images/thermal.png){width=94%}

{{< sim file="sims/perf-lab.html" poster="sims/perf-lab.png" title="Performance Lab: a 20-minute race" height="680" >}}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
Throttling starts after minutes: test as long as players play.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · The long race"}
In **Performance Lab**, compare the P5 uncapped, capped at 30, and low with
a 60 cap; choose one.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 2 · The long race"}
Use Performance Lab. Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="120 fps|0 °C"}
the P5 at the end, high, no cap
:   about 45 fps

the P5 capped at 30
:   a steady 30 fps

the P5 with low graphics, 60 cap
:   a steady 60 fps

what heat does to the chip
:   it throttles
:::
:::

## 27.3 Case study: compatibility

- **Minimum OS version:** API 30 does not start on Android 8.
- **Graphics API:** Vulkan only → black screen on old GPUs.
- **Screen shapes:** anchor menus to the **safe area**.
- A **compatibility matrix** records each device and check.

![Compatibility matrix.](images/compat-matrix.png){width=94%}

![Three screen shapes.](images/aspect.png){width=94%}

{{< sim file="sims/compat-lab.html" poster="sims/compat-lab.png" title="Compatibility Lab: build 43 for every device" height="580" >}}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
Every older version and graphics path adds testing: count the players.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · The matrix"}
Make every row green in **Compatibility Lab**; write the cost of each
change.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 3 · Compatibility"}
Use Compatibility Lab. Choose the fix.

::: {.match extra="a bigger icon|a faster network"}
crash at start on Android 8
:   minimum Android 8 (API 26)

black screen on a GPU without Vulkan
:   add OpenGL ES 3

Start button cut off on a tablet
:   anchor the menu to the safe area

the cost of all three fixes
:   more testing
:::
:::

## 27.4 Following developments with reliable sources

- Read the **release notes** of new OS and engine versions.
- Reliable: official docs, release notes, benchmarks with a method, your
  own tests.
- After an update, test again on an updated device.

![Where do performance facts come from?](images/sources.png){width=94%}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
No number in a report without its source and date.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · A release note"}
Find two game-relevant changes in the newest Android or iOS release notes,
with the source and the date.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 4 · Sources"}
Choose the kind of source.

::: {.match extra="a secret|a guess"}
official release notes of an OS
:   reliable

a forum post without tests
:   a claim to check

your own test log with dates
:   reliable

an undated video with one device
:   a claim to check
:::
:::

## Game challenge: Performance Detective {.challenge}

Work alone. Use every section of today.

Six reports: a race that **jerks** at 58 fps, a **hot phone**, a **crash on
Android 8**, a **black screen**, a **cut-off button** and a **forum claim**.

{{< sim file="sims/perf-detective.html" poster="sims/perf-detective.png" title="Performance Detective: six player reports" kind="game" height="460" >}}

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 5 · The reports"}
Choose the cause or the fix.

::: {.match extra="a full storage|a slow network"}
jerks at 58 fps
:   stutters: look at the 1 % low

slower after 15 minutes, hot
:   thermal throttling

black screen on an old phone
:   no support for the graphics API

"every game 30 % faster"
:   check the release notes and test
:::
:::

## Summary {.summary}

- Measure frame times and the 1 % low, not only the average.
- Heat makes phones throttle; a cap keeps the race steady.
- Builds fail by OS version, graphics API or screen shape.
- A compatibility matrix records every device and check.
- Follow platform changes with reliable sources and your own tests.
